reasoning: This is an abstract UI chrome glyph (move selection/frame to placeholder, or move between screens) with no concrete real-world object. At list size it is easily confused with a logout/exit icon or a crop/fullscreen tool, and tasks about moving or exporting are almost always better served by the object being moved (files, database, boxes, money) or a clearer truck/folder/database icon.
